en-US.name: video-use
en-US.summary: A DesireCore-maintained fork of Browser Use’s video editor for cutting, captioning and rendering video. Audio goes to ElevenLabs Scribe only after you approve the files and track. Transcription requires your own API key and may incur separate charges. Requires Python 3.10+, uv, ffmpeg and ffprobe.

zh-CN.name: video-use 视频剪辑
zh-CN.summary: 基于 Browser Use 的 DesireCore 维护版。可剪辑、制作字幕和渲染视频。仅在你确认素材和音轨后，才将音频发送给 ElevenLabs Scribe。转写需自备 API 密钥，可能另行收费。运行需要 Python 3.10+、uv、ffmpeg 和 ffprobe。

requirements.value: Python 3.10+, uv, ffmpeg and ffprobe on the runtime PATH. The first helper run can install the locked Python dependencies. yt-dlp and animation engines are optional and configured separately.

ElevenLabs Scribe is a separate hosted service. Uncached transcription requires an operator-provided ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in the runtime environment, access to api.elevenlabs.io, and consent to send the selected audio. ElevenLabs terms and privacy policy apply and service usage may be billed separately. If consent or the key is unavailable, use available transcript caches or stop before upload.
